SuperSLM -- vendored source dependency

Tag:    v1.13.1
Commit: d697927f6d5ce5fa73ecbb8660020a425518b923
Base release commit: d697927f6d5ce5fa73ecbb8660020a425518b923
Release status: published release v1.13.1
Source repository: the upstream SuperSLM repository (not this repository)

The Tag line names the release and the Commit line the commit the tag points to. 1.13.1 is v1.13.0 plus
three fixes: default-heap GPU buffers are created in COMMON, their real D3D12 creation state (0d1c3785,
b75bc964, with probes in 002094a6); a GPU page pool is capped at D3D12's required single-resource size for
the adapter, max(128 MiB, min(1/4 of its reported dedicated video memory, 2048 MiB)), refusing a larger pool
with SSLM_GPU_KV_POOL_TOO_LARGE before allocating (2efa82d3; the cap was 2^32 bytes, and the RX 7900 XTX's
driver removed the device on a 4 GiB pool); and the three Windows GPU schema test builders link
gpu_inflight_registry.cpp. The public ABI is 1.13.0's plus one additive GPU verb,
sslm_gpu_kv_pool_max_page_count. Release note: docs/releases/1.13.1.md.

The distribution has 1459 files, excluding .github/ and this vendoring metadata. Each is byte-identical
to git show d697927f6d5ce5fa73ecbb8660020a425518b923:<path>, except the five existing consumer-witness repairs listed below. The library
sources (src/, include/) are byte-identical to the validated candidate 2efa82d3; v1.13.1 adds the version,
docs, the test-builder fix, and main's CI and test tooling changes since v1.13.0.

Raw blobs were read through git ls-tree and git cat-file --batch. The complete SHA-256 manifest
records every file and is checked by ci/check_vendored_tree_matches_manifest.py. The five local
T-3050 witness/tool adaptations to SuperSLMFinishHook::Make are retained unchanged:
route_p_hook_witness.cpp, route_p_run_count.cpp, run_route_p_hook_witness.sh, run_merge_acceptance.sh,
and shim/CoreMinimal.h under tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/. Their hashes remain explicit. The
coherence check (.github/scripts/check_vendored_against_tag.py) reads these Repaired lines: a listed
file may differ from the tag, must still be present, and must actually differ; any other difference fails.
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/route_p_hook_witness.cpp
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/route_p_run_count.cpp
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/run_route_p_hook_witness.sh
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/run_merge_acceptance.sh
Repaired: tools/consumer_reach/route_p_hook/shim/CoreMinimal.h

History: v1.13.0 was re-vendored from v1.11.0 on 2026-10-15, skipping v1.12.0; its 1452 files added the
paged-K/V sources, suites and headers. The 1.13.1 candidates 002094a6 and 2efa82d3 were vendored on
2026-10-17/18 for validation, and v1.13.1 on 2026-10-19. No library source or existing test is removed.
Earlier source pins and the initial v1.2.0 import are retained in Git history.

The v1.13.0 base added two library sources, both in SUPERSLM_CORE_SOURCES, so the wrapper set gains
two unguarded wrappers:
- src/kv_pages.cpp (with its private header src/kv_pages.h), the CPU page pool and page tables:
  Private/Vendored/SuperSLMVendored_kv_pages.cpp.
- src/gpu/gpu_inflight_registry.cpp, which sits under src/gpu/ but is D3D12-free (standard library
  only) and is in the core list, not the superslm_gpu list; src/forward/parallel_split.cpp includes
  its header on every platform: Private/Vendored/SuperSLMVendored_gpu_inflight_registry.cpp, NOT
  guarded by SUPERSLMUNREAL_WITH_GPU.
The superslm_gpu source list is unchanged (gpu_1p0.cpp and superslm_gpu.cpp). The new GPU headers
(gpu_inflight_token.h, submission_ledger.h, gpu_kv_pool_geometry.h, gpu_call_timing_snapshot.h,
gpu_resource_state_tracker.h) are header-only; the state tracker compiles to nothing unless
SUPERSLM_GPU_STATE_TRACKING is defined, and this plugin defines it nowhere. The 1.13.0 CMake
changes beyond the version and those two source lines are test-only (test seams, test suites, and
a configure guard against SUPERSLM_MUTANT_* reaching the production library); this plugin defines
no SUPERSLM_MUTANT_* and no SUPERSLM_ENABLE_KV_PAGES_TEST_SEAMS. (v1.11.0 had added the earlier
core source src/forward/parallel_split.cpp and its wrapper.)

The product change across v1.11.0..v1.13.0:
- 1.12.0, CPU paged K/V: the CPU backend stores K/V in pages of B positions (B follows from the
  model; 64 for Qwen2.5-0.5B at cap 4,096) through a per-holder page table, with tokens and K/V
  values bit-identical to 1.11.0. Thirteen C verbs are added (budget-mode sequences and prefixes,
  page pools, pool and sequence statistics) and one status, SSLM_KV_BUDGET_EXCEEDED (ordinal 29);
  no signature, struct layout or existing ordinal changes. The memory savings come only from the
  new budget-mode verbs. A budget holder saves the new SSB6; a no-budget holder keeps writing
  SSB5, byte-equal to 1.11.0's. The no-budget save was slower than 1.11.0's at 1.12.0 (improved,
  not fully recovered, at 1.13.0, below).
- 1.13.0, GPU paged K/V: GPU page pools, budgeted GPU sequences and prefixes, shared prefix pages
  and the SLM6 save blob, through 12 new gpu_1p0.h verbs and six new SslmGpuStatus values
  (ordinals 24-29: SSLM_GPU_KV_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, SSLM_GPU_KV_POOL_EXHAUSTED,
  SSLM_GPU_KV_POOL_TOO_LARGE, SSLM_GPU_HOLDER_MODE_MISMATCH, SSLM_GPU_PREFIX_REJECTED,
  SSLM_GPU_PREFIX_SCHEMA_MISMATCH). No existing gpu_1p0.h declaration, struct layout or ordinal
  changes. Three gpu_port.h internals change signature (RunLayerLoopGpuSubmit,
  RunLayerLoopGpuFinish, SubmitChunkToFullDepthForG5Bridge); this plugin calls none of them.
  Also: a barrier-race fix in the shipped shaders (eight .hlsl files and site_common.hlsli change;
  the shader count is still 35, and SuperSLMUnreal.Build.cs rebuilds and stages the whole set from
  this tree, so shaders and library come from one release by construction), atomic live-handle
  counts, a faster no-budget CPU save at 16 MiB blocks and up (bytes unchanged), and new SSLM_BUSY
  refusals for a second guarded GPU call while earlier work is unobserved and for two decodes
  raced on one handle (previously undefined). 1.13.0 is verified on the NVIDIA card only; its
  release note says nothing in it is verified on the AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX.

What changed in this plugin for the pin: the two wrappers above; six arms in
SuperSLMGpuStatusMapping.h's exhaustive SslmGpuStatus switch (the pin is a compile break without
them); two arms in its restore mapping, SSLM_GPU_HOLDER_MODE_MISMATCH -> KvMismatch (what an SLM6
blob read through SSLM_SEQUENCE_KV_BUFFER_MISMATCH at 1.12.0 and earlier) and
SSLM_GPU_KV_POOL_EXHAUSTED -> OutOfMemory, with the four non-restore statuses on its default arm
(Malformed); the restore-mapping test's enumerator list; and the CI pins. The plugin calls no
paging verb at this pin.

Legacy mode is unchanged. The CPU save is still SSB5 for every sequence this plugin makes
(byte-equal to 1.11.0's), and the GPU save is still SLM5: a sequence made by
sslm_gpu_seq_create keeps a whole-cap buffer, now addressed through a one-page table that is the
old flat layout by construction. sslm_seq_state_size is 20 bytes larger and remains an upper
bound, and sslm_kv_pool_overhead_size changes only at caps B does not divide; the plugin asks both
verbs rather than assuming their values. sslm_gpu_seq_restore now refuses an SLM6 blob with
SSLM_GPU_HOLDER_MODE_MISMATCH, which no legacy save produces. As at every pin, the Layer-1 tag in
the save wrapper changes, so a save taken at the v1.11.0 pin is refused Layer1Mismatch.

**The first vendoring pass at v1.2.0 (2026-08-22) was corrected the same day**: `git archive`
on Windows applies `.gitattributes`' `text`/`eol=crlf`
line-ending rules exactly as a normal checkout would, so every `*.cpp`/`*.h`/`*.md`/etc. file
(marked `text`, tool-native on checkout) came out CRLF-converted -- 357 of 526 files differed
from the tag by line endings only, content unaffected. `git show <tag>:<path>` does not apply
this conversion -- it returns the raw blob -- so every re-vendoring since, including this one,
reads every file that way instead of via `git archive`.

This plugin never consumes a prebuilt SuperSLM binary. It builds this tree from source with the
engine's own toolchain, which is why
the full CMake project -- including its test and tool executables' source, not only include/
and the library sources -- is vendored: CMakeLists.txt declares those targets unconditionally
at configure time, and configure fails if their sources are absent.

Do not hand-edit Layer 1 engine files under this directory. A correction to SuperSLM is made upstream and
this tree is re-vendored at the new pin. The T-3050 witness repairs above are tracked local exceptions.
`VENDORED_MANIFEST.sha256` records this tree's current per-file hashes, checked by
`ci/tests/test_vendored_tree_checks_run_in_ci.py` against the COMMITTED tree at every `ci/tests`
run -- an unrecorded edit that alters any file's content fails that check. (`ci/check_vendored_tree_matches_manifest.py` and
`ci/check_vendored_wrappers_complete.py` are the checkers; `ci/tests` runs them, and the
repository's coherence-checks workflow runs them too.)
